_description: Atlassian Confluence audit-record log (/wiki/api/v2/audit-records) → AKSI control ID mapping. Confluence is Atlassian's knowledge-management platform — the parallel to Notion for Atlassian-shop customers. Agents create/update pages, archive spaces, export content, and (increasingly) use Confluence as a long-term knowledge surface where what the agent learned yesterday becomes context tomorrow. Each audit record carries a category (page / space / permissions / user / group / global), a summary, an author (with isBot, type=user|appLink), an actionFromAuthor (user / appLink / anonymous), an isAutomatedAction flag, and structured context (changedValues with field-name + old/new). The category+summary pair drives the primary control. Bot-authored pages, bot deletions, large PDF exports, restriction removals, anonymous-access enablement, app-link-driven user provisioning, group-to-space admin grants, and anonymous edits are the central signals. Bot-velocity (one bot doing > N edits in a 1h window) and cross-space (one bot touching > N spaces) yield synthetic PR-02 FLAGs.
